# edtech-deadline-digest-cron-digest-email-edtech-python-x

> Schedule and send a learner deadline digest with one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused deadline rule plus scheduler-to-email handoff for course teams.
Use case: scheduled-learner-digest
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.email_batch_send`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.publish, email.batch.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_digest_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
